_meta.purpose: Conformance golden fixture for one shipped connector (AC4). Locks the connector's per-concept conformance declaration (status/reason/mapper/field_gaps) from discovery/concepts/conformance.py. The CI gate (tests/contract/test_r2_0_b4_t5_conformance_fixtures.py) fails if a shipped connector has no fixture here, and pins each fixture to the registry so a conformance change cannot ship without updating its golden.
_meta.note: Every 'supported' concept's mapper must resolve in T2's mapper registry (discovery.concepts.mappers.resolve_mapper) — the gate checks it. The raw→concept correctness of each mapper is proven by T2's connector-mapping test.

actor_group.reason: teams exist in GitHub but the ingest surface reads repository and PR activity, not org team membership

approval.reason: a PR review approval is a genuine approval record; the connector does not read the reviews endpoint yet

artifact.reason: commits and code files, the two surfaces R18-A2's git content path reads. content_type follows the retrieval substrate: 'code' for a file, 'conversation' for a commit message.

assignment.reason: PR review requests are per-person; there is no group work queue to assign to

state_transition.reason: PR open/review/merge/close is a real transition stream on the same unread per-record surface as work_item

work_item.reason: pull requests are tracked work and the connector reads PR activity, but as aggregate metrics rather than per-PR records — the mapping needs a per-record read
